scope: Original WWII Hell Let Loose; research candidates only, not a runtime manifest.

verification.method: Public source GET; read-only image decoding for dimensions; SHA-256 of unchanged downloaded bytes; visual review of all contact-sheet tiles and 11 selected originals. Crop suggestions are recommendations, not generated derivatives.

rightsNote: Public availability, publisher promotion and existing clan-site use do not establish blanket republication rights. Record provenance and intended-use approval under docs/assets/policy.md before production import. No image binaries are included in this catalog. Gameplay accuracy was not validated.

logistics-and-vehicles.note: Use complete identification panels; obtain a dedicated vehicle scene for a cinematic cover.

spawns-and-engineering.note: Use complete garrison collage; obtain a dedicated construction scene for a cinematic cover.

squad-leader-fieldcraft.note: Keep annotated map intact; use teamwork photo 05 if a separate cover is required.
